\chapter{Boolean Analysis --- Polynomial}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.RandomVariables.Polynomial
\section{Overview}
Independent affine decomposition gives second- and fourth-moment identities for multilinear evaluations. Vanishing odd input moments and bounded fourth-to-second moment ratios imply the degree-dependent generalized Bonami bound.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{theorem}[Moments of an independent affine decomposition]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.MultilinearMoments.affine_moments}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.integrable_mul_pow_of_memLp}
\difficulty{6}
On a probability space let real $A,D,X\in L^4$, assume $X$ is independent of $(A,D)$, and suppose $\E X=\E X^3=0$. Then $\E(A+XD)^2=\E A^2+\E X^2\E D^2$ and $\E(A+XD)^4=\E A^4+6\E X^2\E[A^2D^2]+\E X^4\E D^4$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Cauchy--Schwarz for square functions]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.MultilinearMoments.cauchy_schwarz}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
Let $A,D\in L^4(\mu)$ be real functions on an arbitrary measure space. Then $(\int A^2D^2\,d\mu)^2\le(\int A^4\,d\mu)(\int D^4\,d\mu)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Independence from omitted-coordinate polynomial sums]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.MultilinearMoments.indep_sum_of_notMem}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial}
\difficulty{5}
Let $(X_j)_{j\in[n]}$ be mutually independent, almost everywhere measurable real functions on a measure space $(\Omega,\mu)$, let $s\subseteq[n]$ and $i\notin s$, and let $F,G$ be real coefficient families on subsets of $[n]$. Then $X_i$ is independent of the pair $(\sum_{T\subseteq s}F(T)\prod_{j\in T}X_j,\sum_{T\subseteq s}G(T)\prod_{j\in T}X_j)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Generalized Bonami reasonability bound]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.independent_multilinear_reasonable}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsBReasonable, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.MultilinearMoments.affine_moments, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.MultilinearMoments.cauchy_schwarz, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.MultilinearMoments.indep_sum_of_notMem, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.evalMultilinearRV, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.evalMultilinearRV_memLp, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.multilinear_sum_insert, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.reasonable_moment_algebra, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial.HasDegreeAtMost}
\difficulty{7}
Let $X_1,\ldots,X_n\in L^4$ be mutually independent real random variables on a probability space, with $\E X_i=\E X_i^3=0$ and $\E X_i^4\le B(\E X_i^2)^2$ for every $i$, where $B\ge1$. If $F(X)=\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}F(S)\prod_{i\in S}X_i$ has coefficients zero whenever $|S|>k$, then $F(X)\in L^4$ and $\E F(X)^4\le\max(B,9)^k(\E F(X)^2)^2$.
\end{theorem}
